Hi Olivia — quick technical confirmations below (calling out defaults vs configurable options).

Runtime custody & caching
- KV cache: per-session only (in-memory across worker processes). By default the KV cache is not written to persistent storage; it is discarded when the session ends or after 30 minutes of idle time, whichever comes first.
- Request/response ephemeral buffers: kept in memory for the duration of the request and flushed; not persisted unless logging is explicitly enabled.

Logging & telemetry
- Operational telemetry (model id, tokens consumed, latency, error codes) is retained by default for 30 days for Hosted customers. This is aggregated and tied to request ids; individual token text is not retained in telemetry.
- Full request/response capture (raw prompt + model output) is an opt-in feature. When enabled we store the captured artifacts in the chosen region and under the customer's retention policy.

Opt-in storage behavior
- Embeddings and outputs: stored only when customer enables persistence. Storage location: region pinning available (us, eu, apac).
- Encryption: data at rest is encrypted with per-tenant keys; for Private/Dedicated we support customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) and rewraps.
- Redaction hooks: Redwood supports a pre-persist filter chain (regex masking, custom lambda integration) that can run before any opt-in artifact is written. We can provide sample policies for PHI/SSN masking.

Audit logs & extraction
- Hosted: audit event index (who/when/what) is available via the Console API with 30 day retention by default. Full artifact export for compliance reviews can be enabled; extraction SLA is 48 hours for hosted and 4 hours for Dedicated under standard enterprise contracts.

Migration & rewrapping
- You can change residency for stored artifacts; we offer a migration path that moves encrypted artifacts to the target region and can rewrap keys under your KMS. Migration timelines depend on volume; typical projects take 2–6 weeks (we'll draft a runbook).

Pricing/ops note
- Extended retention or dedicated storage (beyond hosted defaults) impacts cost and will be reflected in the Dedicated offer. We’ll include an estimated line item once Medix confirms desired retention windows.

I attached a short example curl + pre-persist filter snippet to the matrix file (see the sheet "technical-snippets"). Happy to do a 30m deep dive with your infra/security folks if helpful.
